fusions.name: Seeking Lance
fusions.desc: A lance of force that seeks the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage while ignoring resistances, and leaves the target [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushing Pulse
fusions.desc: A pulse that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Recast the Snare
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spell-Scent
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
